issues.witness: A weighted displacement model predicts grasping and opening subgoals by averaging pointwise offsets to four gripper landmarks with learned weights.
issues.reason: The predicted landmarks average scene points plus their offsets, not offsets alone. Omitting the point coordinates changes the geometric operation defining the subgoals.
